subject: Chemistry
title: Atoms are conserved
prompt: Animate 2 H₂ + O₂ → 2 H₂O with atom identities preserved. Explain counting, not the chemical reaction mechanism.
learner: Recognizes hydrogen, oxygen, and molecular formulas.
styleBrief: Particle bookkeeping: fixed atom colors and sizes, spatial regrouping, persistent equation.
criteria: Exactly four hydrogen and two oxygen atoms remain throughout.
Each final water group contains one oxygen and two hydrogens.
Describe the animation as atom accounting, not a reaction pathway.
